verdict.rationale: Requesty has a first-party streaming feature page that describes delivering content token-by-token through its OpenAI-compatible router, so the core capability is directly documented. The evidence does not show that streaming works uniformly across every provider and model, so coverage of the story is incomplete. Missing for 10: explicit documentation that streaming works for any or all providers, documented stream format and provider-normalization details, and independent or hands-on corroboration of streaming behavior.

support.subject: As a developer, I can stream token-by-token responses through the gateway from any provider

citations.quote: Streaming responses provide immediate feedback to users by delivering content token-by-token as it's generated
